title: Pregnant Duo #26
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Korean, in her early 40s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — a professional female bodybuilder physique, carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps, wide flaring lats, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep — and projecting forward from her hard, muscular middle, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, its surface taut and round even where the muscle around it stays hard and defined. Diamond-shaped calves. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, a cold, commanding gaze, soft rose-gold hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real pores, real living eyes, 100 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with opals in copper-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of rose-gold a bracelet. Painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern, a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide cream bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of geometric bird motifs wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, extreme cream extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Indian, in her mid 20s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, bright golden-blonde hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real pores, real living eyes, 150 drop dangles piercings set with rubies in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of rose-gold a necklace. Painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic, a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide carved cream bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of leaf scrolls wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, extreme carved cream extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
